evals.prompt: We're Plausible (plausible.io), a privacy-friendly analytics tool. How visible are we in Google's AI Overviews compared with Fathom and Matomo? I want a baseline before we start GEO work.
evals.expected_output: Drafts a 10-25 prompt set weighted to buying intents with two controls, shows it for approval with a credit estimate, then runs ai_overview per prompt plus traffic and agent_ready per domain. Reports a scorecard with citation, mention and recommendation rates with denominators, a per-prompt table, source mix, citation gaps with what the winning pages do, and ranked fixes. Saves prompts.json and the dated run.
expectations: Shows the prompt set and a credit estimate before running
Includes a brand-name control prompt and an unrelated control prompt
Groups cited sources by type and lists third-party sources that cite competitors but not Plausible
Saves a versioned prompts.json for later runs

evals.prompt: Why does ChatGPT keep recommending HubSpot instead of us (pipedrive.com) when people ask for a CRM for small sales teams?
evals.expected_output: Explains that ScrapeWhale covers Google AI Overviews only, so ChatGPT answers need the browser path or answers the user pastes. Builds a small prompt set around small-sales-team CRM recommendations, runs or collects ChatGPT answers, records brands named in order with framing and cited links, and explains that recommendations mostly reflect third-party consensus, pointing to the sources behind HubSpot's mentions. Suggests ai-seo for the follow-up work.
expectations: Does not claim to have queried ChatGPT through ScrapeWhale
Records the order and framing of the brands named
Distinguishes being cited from being recommended
Points to the third-party sources behind the competitor's recommendations

evals.prompt: Rerun our AI visibility check from last month (ai-visibility/acme/) and tell me what changed.
evals.expected_output: Reuses the saved prompts.json unchanged, reruns it, and leads with the diff: prompts gained and lost per brand, rate changes with both denominators, new cited sources and framing changes. Checks the control prompts and treats single-prompt changes as noise unless they hold.
expectations: Reuses the saved prompt set instead of writing a new one
Leads with what changed since the last run
Checks the control prompts before trusting movements
Saves the new run in a new dated folder
